Build native grassland evapotranspiration from an LPJmL run.

Source: R/grazing_water_lpjml.R
build_grazing_water_lpjml.Rd

Preserve green and blue water consumption from the named rainfed and irrigated grassland stands. The native stand-depth outputs cft_consump_water_g.nc and cft_consump_water_b.nc are weighted by cftfrac.nc and WHEP's spherical 0.5-degree cell areas. One millimetre over one hectare is ten cubic metres. Depth units alone do not establish the spatial basis: a supplied run configuration must declare grid_scaled = false. Its SHA-256 fingerprint is retained in the output.

This is grassland-domain ET before attribution to consumed feed. It is not maximum grazing yield, animal drinking water or a livestock footprint. Use calculate_grazing_water() to select an attribution basis explicitly. Native blue ET remains blue; rainfed stand names do not reclassify water. No country codes or present-day territorial assignments are inferred.

All three cubes must share their recorded model version, commit and run history. Their native annual axes must be consecutive on the noleap calendar, measured in days since January 1. Both grassland bands and every requested year must be supplied. Positional reads require native variable dimension order lon, lat, pft, time, with degree coordinates. Zero-area stands retain their native missing depth and have zero volume; missing area fractions or missing depth on a positive-area stand abort. Ocean/ice cells with no supplied fraction in either grass band and no supplied ET are outside the returned domain. Injected cubes define their own cell population; agreement between cubes does not independently prove coverage of any target territory. Provenance labels and a supplied config identify the inputs; they cannot prove that a config was never edited.

Usage

build_grazing_water_lpjml(
  run_dir = NULL,
  years = NULL,
  config = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  example = FALSE
)

Arguments

run_dir

LPJmL output directory. If NULL, use WHEP_LPJML_RUN_DIR. Not read when complete data is supplied.

years

Integer calendar years. Required for run reads, which load only these years and the two named grass bands. When data is supplied, NULL takes the years from its stand-fraction cube.

config

Path to the run's resolved JSON configuration. Required for run reads because the NetCDF headers do not record grid_scaled. Only explicit false is supported; cell-scaled water aborts.

data

Complete named list of green, blue and stand_frac tibbles keyed by lon, lat, year, band_name, with numeric value. vintage has one row per input with input, units, lpjml_version, lpjml_git_hash, lpjml_run, spatial_basis and source_basis. Water uses mm/yr and spatial basis "stand"; fractions are dimensionless ("" or "1") with basis "cell_fraction". Nonempty source-basis labels identify the evidence for those assertions. No missing list member is silently fetched from another input source.

example

Return a small actual-readback fixture without reading a run. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

A tibble per cell, year, named grass stand and water component, with stand_frac, cell_area_ha, grass_area_ha, native water_mm, extensive grass_water_m3, input-status and source/basis/run metadata. Area and stand-fraction columns repeat across water components; count those areas once. water_scenario identifies the supplied run, not a hypothetical maximum-yield reference experiment.

Examples

build_grazing_water_lpjml(example = TRUE)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 19
#>   component   lon   lat  year band_name         water_mm stand_frac cell_area_ha
#>   <chr>     <dbl> <dbl> <int> <chr>                <dbl>      <dbl>        <dbl>
#> 1 blue      -176. -43.8  2010 rainfed grassland 2.38e-13    0.00912      223288.
#> 2 green     -176. -43.8  2010 rainfed grassland 5.76e+ 2    0.00912      223288.
#> 3 blue      -172. -13.8  2010 rainfed grassland 3.48e-13    0.00731      300248.
#> 4 green     -172. -13.8  2010 rainfed grassland 1.26e+ 3    0.00731      300248.
#> 5 blue      -156.  20.8  2010 rainfed grassland 1.25e- 4    0.152        289057.
#> 6 green     -156.  20.8  2010 rainfed grassland 1.13e+ 3    0.152        289057.
#> # ℹ 11 more variables: grass_area_ha <dbl>, grass_water_m3 <dbl>,
#> #   water_input_status <chr>, source_water <chr>, lpjml_version <chr>,
#> #   lpjml_git_hash <chr>, lpjml_run <chr>, water_input_basis <chr>,
#> #   source_water_basis <chr>, water_scenario <chr>, source_fraction_basis <chr>
